Subject: Q2 numbers checkpoint & Tuesday ops call — submit stage snapshots

Team — quick check-in before Tuesday's ops call. Finance needs clean stage snapshots so we can finalize the Q2 revenue roll-up. Please do the following by EOD Monday: 

- Update stage and close dates for any deals with activity in the past 30 days.
- For all commit-stage deals, add the most recent win probability and a 1-line note on any outstanding blockers.
- Upload a stage snapshot to the shared Drive folder (link below) and attach a brief line-item summary in the comment field.

Call: Tuesday 2027-05-31 09:00 PT (30m) — agenda below. I want a tight sync: confirm commit list, highlight at-risk deals, and agree on next-step owners. If you cannot attend, leave your snapshot and a comment in the sheet.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQ2-Snapshot
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2027-Q2-42

Agenda (ops call):
- 09:00 — Roll call + quick headcount of submitted snapshots (Karthik)
- 09:05 — Commit list review (top 10 by ARR) — owners confirm status (1 min each)
- 09:15 — 2 at-risk deals deep-dive (owner + 2 SMEs)
- 09:25 — Immediate blockers + next-step owners
- 09:28 — Action items & close (Karthik)

Attachments: Q2_stage_snapshot_karthik.xlsx (example format)

Thanks — I know this is busy week but we need clean inputs for the finance roll-up.

— Karthik
